title: Core: AS2 Array built-in methods (slice, splice, indexOf, sort)
description: Test compilation of Array methods: arr.slice(start, end), arr.splice(start, count), arr.splice(start, count, item1), arr.indexOf(item), arr.lastIndexOf(item), arr.sort(), arr.sort(fn), arr.sortOn('field'), arr.sortOn(['f1','f2']), arr.every(fn), arr.some(fn), arr.filter(fn), arr.map(fn). All should compile without error. Verify ActionCallMethod (0x52) + method name string in bytecode.
